text:
Stop asking ChatGPT to "write an article."

You get boring, generic results because your prompt is way too broad.

Fix it fast with these 3 steps:
• Give it a role: "Act as a helpful project manager."
• Add a target: "Explain this update to a non-tech team."
• Set strict rules: "Use short sentences and zero buzzwords."

The bottom line:
Adding clear directions turns robot writing into draft-ready text in seconds.

What is your biggest frustration when using AI?
